subject: general
question: In which year was Bandhan Financial Services, a micro lender based out of Kolkata granted in-principle approval by RBI to start a universal bank?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2014**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **2014** was the year when Bandhan Financial Services, a micro lender based out of Kolkata, was granted in-principle approval by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to start a universal bank.
 
• Bandhan Financial Services was among the two entities that received this approval in 2014, the other being IDFC Limited.
